description: Grid edits as columnar ops (WIRE_FORMAT.md, "Edits as column ops - GridEdit", Phase 1891). SELF-ENUMERATED (27.7): grid-edit/manifest.json names this file, so the directory is one corpus family, grid-edit, which every codec host's corpusFamilies declares. Emitted by the reference host (fuaran-dotnet: FUARAN_REGEN=1 over the GridEditTests of Fuaran.UI.ServerDriven.Tests), whose answers are the columnar op substrate's. BEHAVIOUR vectors, not byte-parity fixtures: tables are the canonical column codec's embedded form, ops the columnar op codec's, deltas the row-delta codec's, compared after decoding. vectors: apply input.edit.op to input.table. A refused op expects refused, the refusal token. Otherwise expected.after is the table it produced; expected.delta the row delta the op induces under the identity input.edit.rowKeyField declares (scheme column:<field>), or, where it declares none, the top delta with referencePath noRowIdentityDeclared; expected.inverse the op that undoes it and expected.undone the table that inverse restores (equal to input.table), or expected.notInvertible true. histories: from input.table, run input.gestures in order through one edit history - edit applies its op, undo applies the most recent undoable edit's inverse, redo re-applies the most recently undone op; a new edit clears what could be redone, and a non-invertible edit clears what could be undone - and compare each entry of expected.steps: the table and both flags, or refused with nothingToUndo, nothingToRedo or a refusal token.

histories.description: two edits, both undone, a third undo refused, one redone
an undone edit is superseded by a new one
a non-invertible edit applies and nothing before it can be undone

vectors.description: a value edit: one row changed by key; the inverse restores the old cell
a cell set to null; the inverse restores the text
a cell set to the value it holds: the empty delta
an edit to the key column: the old key removed, the new one added
the same value edit on a grid declaring no rowKeyField: the top delta, the reference path named
a whole column replaced: every row whose cell moved, by key
a column inserted: the top delta (the schema moved); the inverse removes it
a column removed: the inverse re-inserts it at its index
a row appended: added by key; not invertible, so it ends an undo history
a whole-table transform: the top delta; not invertible
a cell past the last row is refused
a cell of the wrong type is refused
a column that does not exist is refused
inserting a column that exists is refused
an appended row naming an unknown column is refused
